shared_types.name: ButtonVariant
shared_types.description: Visual treatment of a button (B §3; the TS ButtonVariant union).

shared_types.name: ButtonTone
shared_types.description: Intent modifier (004-shared-control-types.md ButtonTone; every tone composes with every variant).

shared_types.name: ControlSize
shared_types.description: The xs-xl control-size ladder (CROSS-07; the TS ControlSize union).

shared_types.name: ControlDensity
shared_types.description: The compact/default/comfortable density ladder (CROSS-08; the TS ControlDensity union).

shared_types.name: SemanticControlSizeRole
shared_types.description: Semantic size offset from inherited presentation (CROSS-07, BTN-04; the TS SemanticControlSizeRole union).

shared_types.name: ButtonFit
shared_types.description: Width mode of the button (B §3, BTN-13).

shared_types.name: ButtonFormEncType
shared_types.description: Per-button form encoding override (B §3; CROSS-03 web-only).

shared_types.name: ButtonFormMethod
shared_types.description: Per-button form method override (B §3; CROSS-03 web-only).

components.name: Button
components.description: A general action trigger for commands, confirmations, and view-level affordances (B §1). g13.005's pilot component: 34 web props, eleven data-* attributes, six anatomy parts, the full variant × tone matrix, and the recipe-hook override chain (BTN-01..23).

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment — primary/secondary/ghost (B §3).

props.name: tone
props.description: Intent modifier; every tone composes with every variant (B §3; 004-shared-control-types ButtonTone).

props.name: size
props.description: Explicit control-size override; default null — resolves from inherited presentation plus sizeRole (B §3, BTN-03; CROSS-07).

props.name: sizeRole
props.description: Semantic size offset from inherited presentation (B §3, BTN-04; CROSS-07).

props.name: density
props.description: Explicit density override; default null — inherited from presentation (B §3, BTN-05; CROSS-08).

props.name: type
props.description: HTML button type (B §3; CROSS-03 web-only).

props.name: form
props.description: External form id to associate with (B §3; CROSS-03 web-only).

props.name: formaction
props.description: Per-button form submission URL override (B §3; CROSS-03 web-only).

props.name: formenctype
props.description: Per-button encoding override; default null (B §3; CROSS-03 web-only).

props.name: formmethod
props.description: Per-button form method override; default null (B §3; CROSS-03 web-only).

props.name: formnovalidate
props.description: Skips form validation for this submit action (B §3; CROSS-03 web-only).

props.name: formtarget
props.description: Per-button browsing context override (B §3; CROSS-03 web-only).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Suppresses activation (B §3, BTN-07).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the spinner, suppresses activation, always emits data-loading (B §3, BTN-08).

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon registry identifier for the leading icon; the component carries it without interpreting the registry (B §3; opaque payload).

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon registry identifier for the trailing icon (B §3; opaque payload).

props.name: chevron
props.description: Renders the trailing disclosure chevron indicator (B §3).

props.name: truncate
props.description: Emits data-truncate; clips an overlong label with ellipsis (B §3, BTN-13).

props.name: fit
props.description: Width mode — default or content shrink-wrap; content emits data-fit (B §3, BTN-13).

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Composed into the inline style as max-width when provided (B §3, BTN-13).

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled toggle state; non-null activates toggle mode with aria-pressed (B §3, BTN-14).

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Initial pressed state for uncontrolled toggle mode (B §3, BTN-14).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name; required when no visible label (B §3, BTN-15/21).

props.name: ariaExpanded
props.description: Disclosure-state hint for menu and accordion triggers; None omits the attribute (B §3/§6, BTN-15; portable Option<bool>).

props.name: describedBy
props.description: aria-describedby target (B §3/§6, BTN-15).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the root (B §3; CROSS-03 web-only DOM-node prop).

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style passthrough for dynamic sizing and CSS-variable overrides (B §3/§6; CROSS-03 web-only DOM-node prop).

props.name: children
props.description: Label content snippet; absence triggers icon-only mode (B §3, BTN-16).

props.name: leading
props.description: Custom leading content snippet, overrides leadingIcon (B §3, BTN-16; CROSS-03 web-only snippet slot).

props.name: trailing
props.description: Custom trailing content snippet, overrides trailingIcon (B §3, BTN-16; CROSS-03 web-only snippet slot).

events.name: onClick

ordering.reason: onPressedChange fires before onClick (B §5, BTN-14; CROSS-06).

events.description: Activation completed; suppressed while disabled or loading (B §5, BTN-14; CROSS-20).

events.name: onPressedChange
events.description: Toggle state changes; fires when the button is in toggle mode, before onClick (B §5, BTN-14).

conditional.description: Shared Spinner primitive, ring/sm/current, rendered when loading (B §2, BTN-08/17).

conditional-documented.condition: present when the leading snippet or leadingIcon prop is provided
present when children content exists; absence triggers icon-only mode
present when the trailing snippet or trailingIcon prop is provided

conditional.description: Disclosure indicator after all content, rendered when chevron is true (B §2, BTN-17).

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The variant value; always emitted (B §9, BTN-18).

attributes.name: data-tone
attributes.description: The tone value, omitted when the tone is default (B §9, BTN-18).

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: The resolved control size (explicit or sizeRole-derived); always emitted (B §9, BTN-18; CROSS-07).

attributes.name: data-density
attributes.description: The resolved density (explicit or inherited); always emitted (B §9, BTN-18; CROSS-08).

attributes.name: data-icon-only
attributes.description: Presence-only; emitted when there is no label content (B §9, BTN-09/18).

attributes.name: data-has-leading
attributes.description: Presence-only; emitted when a leading icon/snippet is present or loading (B §9, BTN-17/18).

attributes.name: data-has-trailing
attributes.description: Presence-only; emitted when a trailing icon/snippet or the chevron is present (B §9, BTN-17/18).

attributes.name: data-truncate
attributes.description: Presence-only; emitted when truncate is true (B §9, BTN-18).

attributes.name: data-fit
attributes.description: The fit value, emitted only when fit is content (B §9, BTN-18).

attributes.name: data-loading
attributes.description: The loading boolean; always emitted, even as false (B §9, BTN-08/18).

attributes.name: data-pressed
attributes.description: The current pressed boolean, emitted only in toggle mode (B §9, BTN-14/18).

ladder.description: Extra-small rung: height 1.5rem, min-width 3.75rem, font-size 0.6875rem; icon-side padding reduces 0.1875rem (B §8, BTN-23).
Small rung: height 1.75rem, min-width 4.25rem, font-size 0.75rem; icon-side padding reduces 0.25rem (B §8, BTN-23).
Default rung: height 2.25rem, min-width 5rem, font-size 0.8125rem; icon-side padding reduces 0.125rem (B §8, BTN-23).
Large rung: height 2.75rem, min-width 5.75rem, font-size 0.875rem; no icon-side padding reduction (B §8, BTN-23).
Extra-large rung: height 3.25rem, min-width 6.5rem, font-size 0.9375rem; icon-side padding adds 0.0625rem (B §8, BTN-23).

fields.name: iconOnly
fields.description: No children content — icon-only mode (B §4/§9, BTN-09).

fields.name: leadingContent
fields.description: Leading snippet or leadingIcon prop present (B §2, BTN-16/17).

fields.name: trailingContent
fields.description: Trailing snippet or trailingIcon prop present (B §2, BTN-16/17).

fields.name: hasLeading
fields.description: leadingContent or loading — drives data-has-leading (B §9, BTN-17).

fields.name: hasTrailing
fields.description: trailingContent or chevron — drives data-has-trailing (B §9, BTN-17).

fields.name: isToggle

fields.name: isUnavailable
fields.description: disabled or loading — activation suppressed (CROSS-20, BTN-07/08).

fields.name: resolvedSize
fields.description: Explicit size or sizeRole resolution (B §7, BTN-03/04; CROSS-07).

fields.name: resolvedDensity
fields.description: Explicit density or inherited presentation (B §8, BTN-05; CROSS-08).

fields.name: resolvedStyle
fields.description: Inline style plus max-width composition (B §3/§9, BTN-13).

visual_state.description: The derived values the web runtimes compute and drawing consumes (B §4/§9; CROSS-14, BTN-19).

extensions.reason: Sub-pixel transform; GPUI cannot render translateY(0.03125rem) (B §12; BTN-26).
extensions.parity_effect: Active state does not press down half a pixel.
extensions.removal_condition: Revisit if GPUI gains sub-pixel transforms.

extensions.reason: GPUI lacks CSS box-shadow support (B §12; BTN-26).
extensions.parity_effect: Variant shadows are not drawn in GPUI.
extensions.removal_condition: Revisit if GPUI adds shadow primitives.

extensions.reason: GPUI text rendering has no letter-spacing API (B §12; BTN-26).
extensions.parity_effect: 0.01em letter-spacing is not applied in GPUI.

extensions.reason: The runtime raises pointer events, not focus ones; a handler for an event that is never delivered is worse than a missing one (B §12; BTN-27).
extensions.parity_effect: onFocus/onBlur are absent in Jetstream; focus arrives with focus plumbing.

extensions.reason: pressed is a spec input there; a host that owns the state derives the change from on_click (B §12; BTN-27).

ButtonVariant::Danger is retained in the Rust enum for backward compatibility and is equivalent to Primary + Danger tone; it is not part of the authored vocabulary (004-shared-control-types.md; BTN-29).
extensions.parity_effect: A legacy Rust value resolves to a defined variant × tone cell instead of a new visual treatment.
extensions.removal_condition: Drop the legacy member once native specs stop constructing it (BTN-29).
